title: Theorem on formal functions at a point of the base
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism] with $Y$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent] and let $y\in Y$, with local ring $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ (a Noetherian local ring) and maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_y$. For $n\ge1$ let $c_n:\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_{Y,y}/\mathfrak m_y^n)\to Y$ be the canonical morphism (induced by $\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\mathcal O_{Y,y}/\mathfrak m_y^n$), $X_n=\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_{Y,y}/\mathfrak m_y^n)\times_YX$ the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] (the $n$th infinitesimal neighbourhood of the fibre $X_1=X_y$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre]), $i_n:X_n\to X$ the projection and $\mathcal F_n=i_n^*\mathcal F$ [def-pc-module-pullback]; the closed immersions $X_n\to X_{n+1}$ (base change of $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_{Y,y}/\mathfrak m_y^n)\to\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_{Y,y}/\mathfrak m_y^{n+1})$) induce maps $H^p(X_{n+1},\mathcal F_{n+1})\to H^p(X_n,\mathcal F_n)$ [pqf-def-cohomology], each $H^p(X_n,\mathcal F_n)$ being an $\mathcal O_{Y,y}/\mathfrak m_y^n$-module. Fix $p\ge0$ and let $M=(R^pf_*\mathcal F)_y$ be the stalk at $y$ of the higher direct image [pqf-def-cohomology], an $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-module, and $M^\wedge=\varprojlim_nM/\mathfrak m_y^nM$ its $\mathfrak m_y$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Since $R^pf_*\mathcal F$ is the sheaf associated with $V\mapsto H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)$, $M=\varinjlim_{V\ni y}H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)$; as $X_n\to X$ factors through $f^{-1}(V)$ for every open $V\ni y$, pulling back along $X_n\to f^{-1}(V)$ defines $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-linear maps $\theta_n:M\to H^p(X_n,\mathcal F_n)$, compatible with the transition maps and vanishing on $\mathfrak m_y^nM$. Then the induced map $\theta:M^\wedge\to\varprojlim_nH^p(X_n,\mathcal F_n)$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-modules (indeed of $\mathcal O_{Y,y}^\wedge$-modules), and its composite with $M\to M^\wedge$ is $(\theta_n)_n$. In particular ($p=0$, $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_X$, so $\mathcal F_n=\mathcal O_{X_n}$) $(f_*\mathcal O_X)_y^\wedge\cong\varprojlim_nH^0(X_n,\mathcal O_{X_n})$ via the maps $(f_*\mathcal O_X)_y\to H^0(X_n,\mathcal O_{X_n})$ sending the germ of $t\in\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}(V))$ to its pullback to $X_n$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma Tag 02OD (lemma-formal-functions-stalk, line 5721) and its proof (flat base change to Spec O_{Y,y}, Lemma 02KH lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology, then Theorem 02OC theorem-formal-functions); the description of the maps theta_n is the one in the proof of Tag 0G7X (perfect.tex, lines 8130-8157), which uses that M^ -> H^0(X_1) is the canonical map
